name: InstantHooverMsg
meaning: Messages handled by InstantHoover_HandleMessage 0x4ce7ea (plus ids it sends)

name: MSG_INVENTORY_STORED
meaning: stored: nearest socket gets 0x6502 if it was ever docked

name: MSG_REMOTE_SWITCH
meaning: RemoteControl held-state begin (arg 1) / end (arg 0); arg 1 while idle and docked opens the hoover

name: MSG_REMOTE_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE
meaning: 1 when not docked (RemoteControl then offers no action)
